_note: Scores the final-validation warning patterns. should_warn: text aimed at the AI that a business owner would not write. should_not_warn: ordinary business text that must not raise a warning. known_miss marks rewordings the patterns are expected to miss today; they count against the catch rate and are listed so nobody mistakes the patterns for complete. baseline is the bar CI holds: fewer catches or more false alarms than this fails the run. Raise it when the patterns improve.
